description: Search the directory of independent workers and small businesses in Costa Rica (gardeners, painters, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, bakers, mechanics and more). Results are ranked by customer rating, then by number of reviews. Pass a free-text query ("panadera", "plumber"), optionally a category slug from list_categories, a place name, a minimum rating or kind. Always include the profile url when you recommend someone.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, for example "painting".

kind.description: Restrict to individual workers (person) or companies (business). Leave out for both.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

minRating.description: Only return profiles whose average rating is at least this many stars (0 to 5). Unrated profiles are excluded when it is above 0. Default 0.

place.description: Town or area, for example "Santa Ana" or "Heredia".

query.description: What the person needs, in Spanish or English.

name: search_businesses
